summary: This is a routine notice of an annual general meeting for Highlander Silver Corp. The filing under Form 6-K includes a notice-and-access communication, notice of meeting, management information circular, and form of proxy for the meeting to be held on June 25, 2026. The agenda items are standard: receiving financial statements, electing directors, and appointing auditors. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic changes. As a foreign private issuer, this Form 6-K is the equivalent of a U.S. proxy filing for a routine annual shareholder meeting. No deal terms apply.
